JEREMIAH 33:6 PRAYER
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace

scenes.a: If a quiet diagnosis in your hand is keeping you awake tonight, stay a moment.
Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them,
and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.
Lord, reach into every broken place of this faithful heart.
Bring your deep restoration where medical answers fall short. Cure every hidden pain, restore weary mind and body,
and pour out your overflowing peace. Let your unwavering truth quiet every fear and steady every step today.
May your presence surround this home like quiet living waters. In Jesus' name we pray, Amen.
Subscribe to The Healing Balm to pray together daily.
